llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit flow is implemented as a writable async Jotai atom action
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: submitPostAtom is defined as atom(null, async (get, set) => {...}), which is a writable async Jotai atom action pattern.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Screen state includes separate atoms for draft text posts list and submit lifecycle
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: There is a draftAtom for a single draft object and a submitLifecycleAtom, but no separate atom representing a list of draft text posts. postsAtom holds submitted posts, not drafts. The requirement asks for a 'draft text posts list' atom distinct from the submit lifecycle atom.
evidence: const draftAtom = atom<{ title: string; body: string }>({ title: '', body: '' })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit action writes pending then commits success or error lifecycle state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The async write sets 'submitting' before the fetch, 'success' on resolution, and 'error' in the catch block, covering all three lifecycle states.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Successful mutation appends or prepends created post data and clears draft input atom
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: On success, the created post is appended to postsAtom and draftAtom is reset to empty strings.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit button triggers the async write atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The submit button calls submitPostAtom.write(null) directly, which is not valid Jotai API. The atom should be dispatched via useSetAtom or the setter from useAtom. Neither useSetAtom nor a useAtom-derived setter for submitPostAtom is used in the component.
